why: P2 #6 of the external audit. `ehTeste` looked at the name only, and a document name falls into BOTH recognizers: `provas/PLANO.md` gets in through the folder, which is in PASTA_TESTE, and `PLANO.teste.md` gets in through NOME_TESTE. The result is a false PASS -- a repository with zero tests and one planning document passed the rule. The `tests__python-name` case had already recorded that `TESTE-1-cabo-KKL.md` does not count, but attributed that to the `-` separator instead of the extension; renaming it to `TESTE.1.cabo.md` was enough to bring the hole back. The fix is a DENIAL of document extensions, and not a list of extensions that count: an allowlist would fail `.dart`, `.R`, `.jl`, `.hs` and `.bats`, and saying "zero test files" to someone who wrote tests costs more than the missing rule. That is why the pass side has a `.bats` -- it goes red if someone swaps the denial for an allowlist. `provas`, `teste` and `TESTE` stay Portuguese: they are the PASTA_TESTE and NOME_TESTE vocabulary.
